# iDataGear · McLearn®

> iDataGear (Intelligence Data Gear) builds McLearn® language learning products, games, offline-first life-logging utilities, and Business Intelligence solutions. Our mission: help people master languages—English, Mandarin Chinese, Cantonese—and help enterprises turn data into actionable intelligence. McLearn® apps are used by learners worldwide on web and Android.

---

## ALL English (All Level Learner's English)

ALL English — All Level Learner's English. CEFR-aligned content from A1 to C2: vocabulary with IPA, sentences, articles, interactive practice tests, and pronunciation practice. Web and Android.

- Web app: https://www.idatagear.com/english/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.learn_english

---

## Learn Chinese

Learn Mandarin Chinese with HSK 1–3 preparation. Vocabulary, pronunciation practice, reading comprehension, and structured learning paths. Web and Android.

- Web app: https://www.idatagear.com/chinese/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.learn_chinese

---

## Learn Cantonese

Learn Cantonese (廣東話) with story-driven lessons, dialogues, Hong Kong slang, and cultural context. Audio-rich practice and offline support. Web and Android.

- Web app: https://www.idatagear.com/cantonese/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.learn_cantonese

---

## Great Cantonese Dictionary

Offline Cantonese dictionary with Jyutping, idioms, tone data, and usage notes. Bookmark favorites and use on the go. Web and Android.

- Web app: https://www.idatagear.com/gcd/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.great_cantonese_dictionary

---

## Xie Zi (写字板)

Master Chinese characters with interactive stroke order practice. HSK-aligned; powered by HanziWriter. Web and Android.

- Web app: https://www.idatagear.com/xiezi/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.xiezi

---

## Open Interview

Practice job interviews with AI-powered mock interviews and instant feedback. Web app.

- Web app: https://www.idatagear.com/interview/

---

## Eyeball It!

Casual visual-estimation puzzle game with three modes: Length & Shapes (drag to match a shape's perimeter), Liquid Volume (pour into a flask to hit a target volume), and Color Volume (mix CMY colors to match a swatch). Web and Android.

- Web app: https://www.idatagear.com/eyeballit/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.eyeballit

---

## Momera.ME

Local-first, private moments journal. Capture life by voice (on-device speech-to-text), text, and photo with ML text recognition — fully offline, nothing leaves your device. Android.

- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.momera
- Privacy: https://www.idatagear.com/privacy-policy-momera-me.html

---

## Momera.Hiking

Offline-first GPS hike tracker: route recording and replay export, geo-tagged photo/video/voice waypoints, offline OpenStreetMap maps, and a hike calendar with history. Web and Android.

- Web app: https://www.idatagear.com/hiking/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.momera.hiking
- Privacy: https://www.idatagear.com/privacy-policy-momera-hiking.html
